rdfs:label: VCard
rdfs:comment: A vCard — a structured contact card holding name, email, phone, address, and other contact details.
notes: Distinct from `urn:solid:Person`: a VCard is the *contact record* (the data), while a Person is the *human*. One Person can have many VCards (work, personal). Pair with `urn:solid:fn`, `urn:solid:hasEmail`, `urn:solid:hasTelephone`, `urn:solid:hasAddress`. Upstream VCard ≡ vcard:Kind, the parent of vcard:Individual, vcard:Organization, vcard:Group and vcard:Location. Prefer the specific subclass (SolidOS contacts type person cards as vcard:Individual).

history.note: Notes explain VCard ≡ vcard:Kind and recommend specific subclasses; added Kind and Individual to seeAlso.
